BiblicalUsage: Cheqer is searching, the patient work of looking into a matter until its depth is found, and Job and the proverbs both use it of God. Job asks whether searching can find out God, and the proverb says the heart of kings is unsearchable, while Isaiah says there is no searching of God's understanding.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God invites our searching but is never exhausted by it, and that is why the search itself is worship. My position is that a God we could fully map would be too small to trust.
